versions.changelog: Consolidates dependency checks, caption fetching, secure caching, and transcript retrieval into one helper. Removes the separate retrieval script and language-specific synonym table while preserving exact keyword, timestamp, and list retrieval modes.

Removes localized natural-language behavior from helper scripts and standardizes them on JSON, status codes, and transcript text. User-facing explanations remain in the agent layer and follow the user's request language.

Merges the read-only Doctor into the fetch helper, removes automatic executable installation metadata, uses locale-aware UI fallback, and makes Chinese-to-English query expansion explicitly opt-in. Preserves the secure per-user cache introduced in 2.0.2.

Secures the transcript cache with a per-user root, ownership and 0700 directory checks, atomic 0600 writes, and symlink rejection. Also removes automatic proxy-port scans, requires explicit CLI language, discloses network access, and narrows bare-link activation.

Declares the Doctor, temporary cache, transcript retrieval, and agent note-generation layers in the manifest; clarifies Research-mode web verification and host confirmation for all state changes; removes remaining scanner ambiguities.

Rebuilds video-digest around Quick, Deep, Research, and Batch Quick modes. Adds a read-only Doctor and transcript fallback, pins yt-dlp with a wheel hash, removes subprocess execution, restricts cache and retrieval paths, and avoids cookie-based access bypass.
discoverability fix — 补全 categories 与 topics（此前落进 other 分类、站内检索不可见）。无内容变更，文件与上一版完全一致。
